C1757.title: Uber MFA Fatigue Attack
C1757.summary: In September 2022, a 17-year-old hacker launched an MFA fatigue attack against Uber. The attacker repeatedly logged in, sending a flood of MFA push requests to an employee's phone, inducing the victim to mistakenly tap "approve."
